title: Light a Candle: Stop Antisemitism 【PZRT2023-S2】
description: the People’s Zoom Readers Theater is hosting a performance and live discussion  event “Better to Light a Single Candle Than to Curse the Darkness:”  Antisemitism.   Our goal is to enlighten people about the causes of antisemitism, respond to a few harmful comments recently publicized in the media,  and inspire people of all backgrounds to combat this form of prejudice as well as every other- together.   We hope you can join us and share your thoughts.
